run_boostbuild_test_conditionals: run a BoostBuild test that verifies conditionals returning conditionals in Jamfile build rules
write_test_file_with_boostbuild: use BoostBuild Tester to write a source file and Jamfile for testing build rules
test_conditional_feature_propagation: test that a propagated feature conditional is correctly applied during variant-specific builds
run_build_system_with_tester: run the Boost.Build build system against test files using the Tester harness
cleanup_boostbuild_test_environment: clean up the BoostBuild test environment after running build system tests
